description: What changed since a cursor, summarised per email, each open exactly once. Meant to run without the owner asking, as one permanent recurring job every 10 to 15 minutes: it says which emails are worth telling the owner about right now (first open, a new device, a return after a pause) and which are noise. First call (or after losing the cursor): since = an ISO time such as when tracking started or just before your last check. Then pass back the returned cursor and keep it in durable notes.

since.description: ISO-8601 time or the cursor returned by the previous call.

name: didtheyopen_new_opens
title: New opens across all emails
